1. Open Authentik Account Setup
Option A: Automatic ?next= Parameter (Built In) Zero Config

The Open Authentik Account Setup button on this page automatically appends ?next=<this_page_url>?enrolled=true to your Authentik Flow Context. Also, if a user opens Authentik in a new tab and switches back to this browser tab after enrolling, this page automatically detects their return and advances to Step 2.

Option B: Authentik Redirect Stage (For Direct Email Invites) Authentik Docs ↗

In Authentik Admin, open Flows and Stages → Stages → New Stage → Redirect Stage, set mode to Static, and set Target URL to this page with ?enrolled=true. Bind that stage at the end of your Enrollment Flow (e.g., Order 100) so even emailed invitation links land right back here on Step 2!

Common Questions & Login Tips

Why is Audiobookshelf iOS TestFlight full?

Apple caps TestFlight beta slots at 10,000 users. If slots are full, install Plappa or ShelfPlayer from the App Store—both support native iOS playback, offline downloads, and OpenID SSO!

Roku says Jellyfin requires a subscription?

Per the official Jellyfin Roku note, Roku's store displays a generic cable/satellite notice due to a store limitation. Jellyfin is 100% free—just install Jellyfin for Roku and connect to our server URL.

Can't log into Jellyfin on a TV app?

Make sure you type your Authentik username (not your email address) and password, or log into Jellyfin in your phone's web browser first and use Quick Connect to authorize your TV in seconds.
